R4: the gauge is never a grade, never stored as a score, and never hides, ranks or orders what members see
R5: a recipient who may not see the question, or the document a find rests on, is not offered it

R6: a find's only doors are a member's: dismiss (the queue's in a drawing project; a follower outside every one mutes it), accept by one act in record-grammar R52's forms, hold a hypothesis, or start a step; nothing here writes a leg, a grade, a conclusion or a hypothesis
R6: a follower outside every drawing project mutes a find; a participant of a drawing project dismisses it through the queue, not here

R1: a refusal from exploreAllowed opens nothing and the next owner is asked; {ask: true} records exploreAsk with the questions and their estimate, and nothing runs that day without approval
R1: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick for the scheduler; exploreAllowed decides each owner and question; null opens one run, at most one a question a day
R10: an exploring run gathers about at most 20 distinct persons; a look past the cap is refused EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED and the run ends its step set_aside with that reason
R11: a group's own test investigations measure the explorer too; the result, with its false-alarm rate, is answered to that group's members only, and never opens or closes R7's gate
R12: at its close each run carries ai-runs R76's actual cost, answered to the paying account's owners only
R12: each Ask item and each run carries ai-use R10's estimate before
R13: a run reads inside a held document through run-productions R24, a few pages at a time within its pages bound, never a document under a no-AI material limit; it says how far it read

R13: the material limit is read from ai-accounts (its R22's aiKeptAway, asked with the document's project and the use explore); a read that throws is answered its fail-closed refusal (ai-accounts R34's KEPT_AWAY_UNREADABLE), nothing read
R13: what an exploring run proposes while reading is run-productions R21's, under its step (K2502); a proposed connection to a person passes R9's gate first

R14: a find that cuts against what the question's members hold is offered exactly as prominently as one that supports it: the same item, kind, place and order rule; nothing orders, groups or filters by bearing

R15: questionExplorerOf answers its instance with its tables already created, migrated before they are declared to purge: a host that never calls migrate() reads, ticks and purges without error; migrate() stays callable and idempotent
R16, R15: a store made before the label gains its column at migrate(), its finds kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R16: on a test instance with no record and investigate's chain held, the gate is open on the exception: R4's answer carries false_alarm_rate null, gold_set null and untested the label, and each find R5 offers carries it; control: a non-test instance with no record stays shut, R5 answering nothing
R16: the exception lifts only the bar: with investigate's verification chain not held the gate stays shut on a test instance; a part the exception does not admit shuts it
R16: whenever the explorer's bar is held, R7's recorded false-alarm rate of at most 20% applies and no label is carried, on a test instance too; a find keeps the label it was gauged under
R17, R15: a store made before the close_refused column gains it at migrate(), its runs kept, and migrate() stays idempotent
R17: a close ai-runs refuses is carried in the answer (closed: false, the plane's code) and the row records that the end was not accepted; it never throws, and the run can be ended again
R17: a condition outside CONDITION_KINDS is refused before anything is closed; one in it is passed to the close as given
R17: a limit this module names ends the run with bound completed unless the caller names a bound of the record; a named bound passes through (R8)
R17: end({end: "ended"}) closes with bound completed and no condition, and the words for the ending are not this module's
R17: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick answer promises (scheduler R27 awaits them)
R17: the cap ends the run closed: ai-runs' asynchronous close is awaited and accepted, bound completed and condition null, the step set aside with EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED
R17: the opening of a run answers after ai-runs has answered: a slow asynchronous open is awaited, and two ticks never open a question twice; a refused or failing open leaves no run

R3: it asks to capture only through capture-requests, each request carrying the step; an address the record does not hold is named to the members R5 reaches, who capture it

questionExplorerOf answers one instance per storage; the constants are as the requirements state them
R1: a refusal from exploreAllowed opens nothing and the next owner is asked; {ask: true} records exploreAsk with the questions and their estimate, and nothing runs that day without approval
R1: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick for the scheduler; exploreAllowed decides each owner and question; null opens one run, at most one a question a day
R10: an exploring run gathers about at most 20 distinct persons; a look past the cap is refused EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED and the run ends its step set_aside with that reason
R11: a group's own test investigations measure the explorer too; the result, with its false-alarm rate, is answered to that group's members only, and never opens or closes R7's gate
R12: at its close each run carries ai-runs R76's actual cost, answered to the paying account's owners only
R12: each Ask item and each run carries ai-use R10's estimate before
R13: a run reads inside a held document through run-productions R24, a few pages at a time within its pages bound, never a document under a no-AI material limit; it says how far it read

R13: the material limit is read from ai-accounts (its R22's aiKeptAway, asked with the document's project and the use explore); a read that throws is answered its fail-closed refusal (ai-accounts R34's KEPT_AWAY_UNREADABLE), nothing read
R13: what an exploring run proposes while reading is run-productions R21's, under its step (K2502); a proposed connection to a person passes R9's gate first

R14: a find that cuts against what the question's members hold is offered exactly as prominently as one that supports it: the same item, kind, place and order rule; nothing orders, groups or filters by bearing

R15: questionExplorerOf answers its instance with its tables already created, migrated before they are declared to purge: a host that never calls migrate() reads, ticks and purges without error; migrate() stays callable and idempotent
R16, R15: a store made before the label gains its column at migrate(), its finds kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R16: on a test instance with no record and investigate's chain held, the gate is open on the exception: R4's answer carries false_alarm_rate null, gold_set null and untested the label, and each find R5 offers carries it; control: a non-test instance with no record stays shut, R5 answering nothing
R16: the exception lifts only the bar: with investigate's verification chain not held the gate stays shut on a test instance; a part the exception does not admit shuts it
R16: whenever the explorer's bar is held, R7's recorded false-alarm rate of at most 20% applies and no label is carried, on a test instance too; a find keeps the label it was gauged under
R17, R15: a store made before the close_refused column gains it at migrate(), its runs kept, and migrate() stays idempotent
R17: a close ai-runs refuses is carried in the answer (closed: false, the plane's code) and the row records that the end was not accepted; it never throws, and the run can be ended again
R17: a condition outside CONDITION_KINDS is refused before anything is closed; one in it is passed to the close as given
R17: a limit this module names ends the run with bound completed unless the caller names a bound of the record; a named bound passes through (R8)
R17: end({end: "ended"}) closes with bound completed and no condition, and the words for the ending are not this module's
R17: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick answer promises (scheduler R27 awaits them)
R17: the cap ends the run closed: ai-runs' asynchronous close is awaited and accepted, bound completed and condition null, the step set aside with EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED
R17: the opening of a run answers after ai-runs has answered: a slow asynchronous open is awaited, and two ticks never open a question twice; a refused or failing open leaves no run
R2: R9 holds before it: a question about a person no member tied is never chosen; one a member raised about that person is
R2: worth exploring: open or surfaced, at least one member receives its finds, and never explored or a capture resolving to its subject entity gained since its last run; bounded at 200 a tick

R3: a member's account's explore switch is read through ai-accounts' in-plane accountUsesOf (its R17), never accountUses as that member; an account that cannot be read is refused before ai-use is asked (fail closed)

R3: a principal served by a sign-in explores only while that sign-in account's explore use is on; off (its default) it is refused as any account whose explore use is off (ai-accounts R14 and ai-use R6, the real modules; the sign-in held, ai-accounts R19)
R3: it asks to capture only through capture-requests, each request carrying the step; an address the record does not hold is named to the members R5 reaches, who capture it
R3: it reads within its principal's sight: the group's, what every member may see; a project's, its participants'

R4: the gauge is never a grade, never stored as a score, and never hides, ranks or orders what members see

R5: a recipient who may not see the question, or the document a find rests on, is not offered it

R1: a refusal from exploreAllowed opens nothing and the next owner is asked; {ask: true} records exploreAsk with the questions and their estimate, and nothing runs that day without approval
R1: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick for the scheduler; exploreAllowed decides each owner and question; null opens one run, at most one a question a day
R10: an exploring run gathers about at most 20 distinct persons; a look past the cap is refused EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED and the run ends its step set_aside with that reason
R11: a group's own test investigations measure the explorer too; the result, with its false-alarm rate, is answered to that group's members only, and never opens or closes R7's gate
R12: at its close each run carries ai-runs R76's actual cost, answered to the paying account's owners only
R12: each Ask item and each run carries ai-use R10's estimate before
R13: a run reads inside a held document through run-productions R24, a few pages at a time within its pages bound, never a document under a no-AI material limit; it says how far it read

R13: the material limit is read from ai-accounts (its R22's aiKeptAway, asked with the document's project and the use explore); a read that throws is answered its fail-closed refusal (ai-accounts R34's KEPT_AWAY_UNREADABLE), nothing read
R13: what an exploring run proposes while reading is run-productions R21's, under its step (K2502); a proposed connection to a person passes R9's gate first

R14: a find that cuts against what the question's members hold is offered exactly as prominently as one that supports it: the same item, kind, place and order rule; nothing orders, groups or filters by bearing

R15: questionExplorerOf answers its instance with its tables already created, migrated before they are declared to purge: a host that never calls migrate() reads, ticks and purges without error; migrate() stays callable and idempotent
R16, R15: a store made before the label gains its column at migrate(), its finds kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R16: on a test instance with no record and investigate's chain held, the gate is open on the exception: R4's answer carries false_alarm_rate null, gold_set null and untested the label, and each find R5 offers carries it; control: a non-test instance with no record stays shut, R5 answering nothing
R16: the exception lifts only the bar: with investigate's verification chain not held the gate stays shut on a test instance; a part the exception does not admit shuts it
R16: whenever the explorer's bar is held, R7's recorded false-alarm rate of at most 20% applies and no label is carried, on a test instance too; a find keeps the label it was gauged under
R17, R15: a store made before the close_refused column gains it at migrate(), its runs kept, and migrate() stays idempotent
R17: a close ai-runs refuses is carried in the answer (closed: false, the plane's code) and the row records that the end was not accepted; it never throws, and the run can be ended again
R17: a condition outside CONDITION_KINDS is refused before anything is closed; one in it is passed to the close as given
R17: a limit this module names ends the run with bound completed unless the caller names a bound of the record; a named bound passes through (R8)
R17: end({end: "ended"}) closes with bound completed and no condition, and the words for the ending are not this module's
R17: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick answer promises (scheduler R27 awaits them)
R17: the cap ends the run closed: ai-runs' asynchronous close is awaited and accepted, bound completed and condition null, the step set aside with EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED
R17: the opening of a run answers after ai-runs has answered: a slow asynchronous open is awaited, and two ticks never open a question twice; a refused or failing open leaves no run
R2: R9 holds before it: a question about a person no member tied is never chosen; one a member raised about that person is
R2: worth exploring: open or surfaced, at least one member receives its finds, and never explored or a capture resolving to its subject entity gained since its last run; bounded at 200 a tick

R3: a member's account's explore switch is read through ai-accounts' in-plane accountUsesOf (its R17), never accountUses as that member; an account that cannot be read is refused before ai-use is asked (fail closed)

R3: a principal served by a sign-in explores only while that sign-in account's explore use is on; off (its default) it is refused as any account whose explore use is off (ai-accounts R14 and ai-use R6, the real modules; the sign-in held, ai-accounts R19)
R3: it asks to capture only through capture-requests, each request carrying the step; an address the record does not hold is named to the members R5 reaches, who capture it
R3: it reads within its principal's sight: the group's, what every member may see; a project's, its participants'

R3: the run opens through ai-runs in the investigate run path, origin explore, use explore, the paying owner its principal and ai-use R6's label, as a system step on the question that ai-runs creates once the run is open (K2490)
R4 R6 R8 R9 R10 R13 (plan rule 6): every refusal row's translation is the word of its refusal.<CODE> key, read through setup-words, and none says group where the list says team

R4: each find (a capture, content row or connection the run located) is gauged supports, cuts_against or unclear against the question's live basis, answered {bearing, how, false_alarm_rate, gold_set, label: machine, enabled_by} (R16: untested null under the bar)
R4: the gauge is never a grade, never stored as a score, and never hides, ranks or orders what members see
R5 R8 R12 (plan rule 6): the system step's words, an offered find's and a stop's are the list's, and the gate's reasons and estimate too
R5 R8 R9 R10 (plan rule 6): the module's keys are the owner's declared list for question-explorer, every one held by the word list
R5: a recipient who may not see the question, or the document a find rests on, is not offered it

R5: findsFor answers each find, once (keyed per find and question), to each of steps.findRecipients who may see both the find and the question; labelled the system's, never a project's; which account paid only to its owners
R6 R13 (plan rule 6): a find's route and a proposal's aim are the list's words; a placeholder with no value is refused, never answered bare

R6: a find's only doors are a member's: dismiss (the queue's in a drawing project; a follower outside every one mutes it), accept by one act in record-grammar R52's forms, hold a hypothesis, or start a step; nothing here writes a leg, a grade, a conclusion or a hypothesis
R6: a follower outside every drawing project mutes a find; a participant of a drawing project dismisses it through the queue, not here

R8: a run stopped by a limit ends its step set_aside with the reason; only its enabling owner is told; no place is named

R9: a look aimed at a person no member tied to the question is refused EXPLORE_PERSON_NOT_TIED, recorded on the run, and the run goes on; a tied person is looked at

R1: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick for the scheduler; exploreAllowed decides each owner and question; null opens one run, at most one a question a day
R10: an exploring run gathers about at most 20 distinct persons; a look past the cap is refused EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED and the run ends its step set_aside with that reason
R11: a group's own test investigations measure the explorer too; the result, with its false-alarm rate, is answered to that group's members only, and never opens or closes R7's gate
R12: at its close each run carries ai-runs R76's actual cost, answered to the paying account's owners only
R12: each Ask item and each run carries ai-use R10's estimate before
R13: a run reads inside a held document through run-productions R24, a few pages at a time within its pages bound, never a document under a no-AI material limit; it says how far it read

R13: the material limit is read from ai-accounts (its R22's aiKeptAway, asked with the document's project and the use explore); a read that throws is answered its fail-closed refusal (ai-accounts R34's KEPT_AWAY_UNREADABLE), nothing read
R13: what an exploring run proposes while reading is run-productions R21's, under its step (K2502); a proposed connection to a person passes R9's gate first

R14: a find that cuts against what the question's members hold is offered exactly as prominently as one that supports it: the same item, kind, place and order rule; nothing orders, groups or filters by bearing

R15: questionExplorerOf answers its instance with its tables already created, migrated before they are declared to purge: a host that never calls migrate() reads, ticks and purges without error; migrate() stays callable and idempotent
R16, R15: a store made before the label gains its column at migrate(), its finds kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R16: on a test instance with no record and investigate's chain held, the gate is open on the exception: R4's answer carries false_alarm_rate null, gold_set null and untested the label, and each find R5 offers carries it; control: a non-test instance with no record stays shut, R5 answering nothing
R16: the exception lifts only the bar: with investigate's verification chain not held the gate stays shut on a test instance; a part the exception does not admit shuts it
R16: whenever the explorer's bar is held, R7's recorded false-alarm rate of at most 20% applies and no label is carried, on a test instance too; a find keeps the label it was gauged under
R17, R15: a store made before the close_refused column gains it at migrate(), its runs kept, and migrate() stays idempotent
R17: a close ai-runs refuses is carried in the answer (closed: false, the plane's code) and the row records that the end was not accepted; it never throws, and the run can be ended again
R17: a condition outside CONDITION_KINDS is refused before anything is closed; one in it is passed to the close as given
R17: a limit this module names ends the run with bound completed unless the caller names a bound of the record; a named bound passes through (R8)
R17: end({end: "ended"}) closes with bound completed and no condition, and the words for the ending are not this module's
R17: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick answer promises (scheduler R27 awaits them)
R17: the cap ends the run closed: ai-runs' asynchronous close is awaited and accepted, bound completed and condition null, the step set aside with EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED
R17: the opening of a run answers after ai-runs has answered: a slow asynchronous open is awaited, and two ticks never open a question twice; a refused or failing open leaves no run
R2: R9 holds before it: a question about a person no member tied is never chosen; one a member raised about that person is
R2: worth exploring: open or surfaced, at least one member receives its finds, and never explored or a capture resolving to its subject entity gained since its last run; bounded at 200 a tick

R3: a member's account's explore switch is read through ai-accounts' in-plane accountUsesOf (its R17), never accountUses as that member; an account that cannot be read is refused before ai-use is asked (fail closed)

R3: a principal served by a sign-in explores only while that sign-in account's explore use is on; off (its default) it is refused as any account whose explore use is off (ai-accounts R14 and ai-use R6, the real modules; the sign-in held, ai-accounts R19)
R3: it asks to capture only through capture-requests, each request carrying the step; an address the record does not hold is named to the members R5 reaches, who capture it
R3: it reads within its principal's sight: the group's, what every member may see; a project's, its participants'

R3: the run opens through ai-runs in the investigate run path, origin explore, use explore, the paying owner its principal and ai-use R6's label, as a system step on the question that ai-runs creates once the run is open (K2490)
R4 R6 R8 R9 R10 R13 (plan rule 6): every refusal row's translation is the word of its refusal.<CODE> key, read through setup-words, and none says group where the list says team

R4: each find (a capture, content row or connection the run located) is gauged supports, cuts_against or unclear against the question's live basis, answered {bearing, how, false_alarm_rate, gold_set, label: machine, enabled_by} (R16: untested null under the bar)
R4: the gauge is never a grade, never stored as a score, and never hides, ranks or orders what members see
R5 R8 R12 (plan rule 6): the system step's words, an offered find's and a stop's are the list's, and the gate's reasons and estimate too
R5 R8 R9 R10 (plan rule 6): the module's keys are the owner's declared list for question-explorer, every one held by the word list
R5: a recipient who may not see the question, or the document a find rests on, is not offered it

R5: findsFor answers each find, once (keyed per find and question), to each of steps.findRecipients who may see both the find and the question; labelled the system's, never a project's; which account paid only to its owners
R6 R13 (plan rule 6): a find's route and a proposal's aim are the list's words; a placeholder with no value is refused, never answered bare

R6: a find's only doors are a member's: dismiss (the queue's in a drawing project; a follower outside every one mutes it), accept by one act in record-grammar R52's forms, hold a hypothesis, or start a step; nothing here writes a leg, a grade, a conclusion or a hypothesis
R6: a follower outside every drawing project mutes a find; a participant of a drawing project dismisses it through the queue, not here

R7: finds are offered only while the gate is open: the explorer passed its bar on Civicsmith's test investigations, its false-alarm rate at most 20% and recorded, and run-rules R19 lets investigate and the explorer's use deploy; closed, findsFor answers nothing and counts nothing, and no member is offered exploring
R8: a run stopped by a limit ends its step set_aside with the reason; only its enabling owner is told; no place is named
R9, R10, R13: each refusal this module mints is its own row, frozen, with a translation in plain words and the site that mints it; a relayed provider's code is never copied here
R9: a look aimed at a person no member tied to the question is refused EXPLORE_PERSON_NOT_TIED, recorded on the run, and the run goes on; a tied person is looked at
the module's tables are declared to record-core's purge by the question they serve (and a find by its documents): a question's purge takes its own rows, a document's purge its finds

R1: a refusal from exploreAllowed opens nothing and the next owner is asked; {ask: true} records exploreAsk with the questions and their estimate, and nothing runs that day without approval
R1: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick for the scheduler; exploreAllowed decides each owner and question; null opens one run, at most one a question a day
R10: an exploring run gathers about at most 20 distinct persons; a look past the cap is refused EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED and the run ends its step set_aside with that reason
R11: a group's own test investigations measure the explorer too; the result, with its false-alarm rate, is answered to that group's members only, and never opens or closes R7's gate
R12: at its close each run carries ai-runs R76's actual cost, answered to the paying account's owners only
R12: each Ask item and each run carries ai-use R10's estimate before
R13: a run reads inside a held document through run-productions R24, a few pages at a time within its pages bound, never a document under a no-AI material limit; it says how far it read

R13: the material limit is read from ai-accounts (its R22's aiKeptAway, asked with the document's project and the use explore); a read that throws is answered its fail-closed refusal (ai-accounts R34's KEPT_AWAY_UNREADABLE), nothing read
R13: what an exploring run proposes while reading is run-productions R21's, under its step (K2502); a proposed connection to a person passes R9's gate first

R14: a find that cuts against what the question's members hold is offered exactly as prominently as one that supports it: the same item, kind, place and order rule; nothing orders, groups or filters by bearing

R15: questionExplorerOf answers its instance with its tables already created, migrated before they are declared to purge: a host that never calls migrate() reads, ticks and purges without error; migrate() stays callable and idempotent
R16, R15: a store made before the label gains its column at migrate(), its finds kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R16: on a test instance with no record and investigate's chain held, the gate is open on the exception: R4's answer carries false_alarm_rate null, gold_set null and untested the label, and each find R5 offers carries it; control: a non-test instance with no record stays shut, R5 answering nothing
R16: the exception lifts only the bar: with investigate's verification chain not held the gate stays shut on a test instance; a part the exception does not admit shuts it

R17: a close ai-runs refuses is carried in the answer (closed: false, the plane's code) and the row records that the end was not accepted; it never throws, and the run can be ended again

R6: a follower outside every drawing project mutes a find; a participant of a drawing project dismisses it through the queue, not here

R8: a run stopped by a limit ends its step set_aside with the reason; only its enabling owner is told; no place is named
R9, R10, R13: each refusal this module mints is its own row, frozen, with a translation in plain words and the site that mints it; a relayed provider's code is never copied here
R9: a look aimed at a person no member tied to the question is refused EXPLORE_PERSON_NOT_TIED, recorded on the run, and the run goes on; a tied person is looked at

tests: R3: it reads within its principal's sight: the group's, what every member may see; a project's, its participants'
R3: it asks to capture only through capture-requests, each request carrying the step; an address the record does not hold is named to the members R5 reaches, who capture it
R8: a run stopped by a limit ends its step set_aside with the reason; only its enabling owner is told; no place is named
R9: a look aimed at a person no member tied to the question is refused EXPLORE_PERSON_NOT_TIED, recorded on the run, and the run goes on; a tied person is looked at
R10: an exploring run gathers about at most 20 distinct persons; a look past the cap is refused EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED and the run ends its step set_aside with that reason
R12: at its close each run carries ai-runs R76's actual cost, answered to the paying account's owners only
R13: a run reads inside a held document through run-productions R24, a few pages at a time within its pages bound, never a document under a no-AI material limit; it says how far it read
R13: what an exploring run proposes while reading is run-productions R21's, under its step (K2502); a proposed connection to a person passes R9's gate first

R13: the material limit is read from ai-accounts (its R22's aiKeptAway, asked with the document's project and the use explore); a read that throws is answered its fail-closed refusal (ai-accounts R34's KEPT_AWAY_UNREADABLE), nothing read
R1: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick for the scheduler; exploreAllowed decides each owner and question; null opens one run, at most one a question a day
R1: a refusal from exploreAllowed opens nothing and the next owner is asked; {ask: true} records exploreAsk with the questions and their estimate, and nothing runs that day without approval
R2: worth exploring: open or surfaced, at least one member receives its finds, and never explored or a capture resolving to its subject entity gained since its last run; bounded at 200 a tick
R2: R9 holds before it: a question about a person no member tied is never chosen; one a member raised about that person is

R3: the run opens through ai-runs in the investigate run path, origin explore, use explore, the paying owner its principal and ai-use R6's label, as a system step on the question that ai-runs creates once the run is open (K2490)

R3: a principal served by a sign-in explores only while that sign-in account's explore use is on; off (its default) it is refused as any account whose explore use is off (ai-accounts R14 and ai-use R6, the real modules; the sign-in held, ai-accounts R19)
R12: each Ask item and each run carries ai-use R10's estimate before

R3: a member's account's explore switch is read through ai-accounts' in-plane accountUsesOf (its R17), never accountUses as that member; an account that cannot be read is refused before ai-use is asked (fail closed)
R17: the cap ends the run closed: ai-runs' asynchronous close is awaited and accepted, bound completed and condition null, the step set aside with EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED
R17: a limit this module names ends the run with bound completed unless the caller names a bound of the record; a named bound passes through (R8)
R17: end({end: "ended"}) closes with bound completed and no condition, and the words for the ending are not this module's
R17: a condition outside CONDITION_KINDS is refused before anything is closed; one in it is passed to the close as given
R17: a close ai-runs refuses is carried in the answer (closed: false, the plane's code) and the row records that the end was not accepted; it never throws, and the run can be ended again
R17: the opening of a run answers after ai-runs has answered: a slow asynchronous open is awaited, and two ticks never open a question twice; a refused or failing open leaves no run
R17: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick answer promises (scheduler R27 awaits them)
R17, R15: a store made before the close_refused column gains it at migrate(), its runs kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R16: on a test instance with no record and investigate's chain held, the gate is open on the exception: R4's answer carries false_alarm_rate null, gold_set null and untested the label, and each find R5 offers carries it; control: a non-test instance with no record stays shut, R5 answering nothing
R16: the exception lifts only the bar: with investigate's verification chain not held the gate stays shut on a test instance; a part the exception does not admit shuts it
R16: whenever the explorer's bar is held, R7's recorded false-alarm rate of at most 20% applies and no label is carried, on a test instance too; a find keeps the label it was gauged under
R16, R15: a store made before the label gains its column at migrate(), its finds kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R4: each find (a capture, content row or connection the run located) is gauged supports, cuts_against or unclear against the question's live basis, answered {bearing, how, false_alarm_rate, gold_set, label: machine, enabled_by} (R16: untested null under the bar)
R4: the gauge is never a grade, never stored as a score, and never hides, ranks or orders what members see

R5: findsFor answers each find, once (keyed per find and question), to each of steps.findRecipients who may see both the find and the question; labelled the system's, never a project's; which account paid only to its owners
R5: a recipient who may not see the question, or the document a find rests on, is not offered it

R6: a find's only doors are a member's: dismiss (the queue's in a drawing project; a follower outside every one mutes it), accept by one act in record-grammar R52's forms, hold a hypothesis, or start a step; nothing here writes a leg, a grade, a conclusion or a hypothesis
R6: a follower outside every drawing project mutes a find; a participant of a drawing project dismisses it through the queue, not here

R7: finds are offered only while the gate is open: the explorer passed its bar on Civicsmith's test investigations, its false-alarm rate at most 20% and recorded, and run-rules R19 lets investigate and the explorer's use deploy; closed, findsFor answers nothing and counts nothing, and no member is offered exploring
R11: a group's own test investigations measure the explorer too; the result, with its false-alarm rate, is answered to that group's members only, and never opens or closes R7's gate

R14: a find that cuts against what the question's members hold is offered exactly as prominently as one that supports it: the same item, kind, place and order rule; nothing orders, groups or filters by bearing
R9, R10, R13: each refusal this module mints is its own row, frozen, with a translation in plain words and the site that mints it; a relayed provider's code is never copied here
the module's tables are declared to record-core's purge by the question they serve (and a find by its documents): a question's purge takes its own rows, a document's purge its finds
questionExplorerOf answers one instance per storage; the constants are as the requirements state them

R15: questionExplorerOf answers its instance with its tables already created, migrated before they are declared to purge: a host that never calls migrate() reads, ticks and purges without error; migrate() stays callable and idempotent
R5 R8 R9 R10 (plan rule 6): the module's keys are the owner's declared list for question-explorer, every one held by the word list
R4 R6 R8 R9 R10 R13 (plan rule 6): every refusal row's translation is the word of its refusal.<CODE> key, read through setup-words, and none says group where the list says team
R5 R8 R12 (plan rule 6): the system step's words, an offered find's and a stop's are the list's, and the gate's reasons and estimate too
R6 R13 (plan rule 6): a find's route and a proposal's aim are the list's words; a placeholder with no value is refused, never answered bare

outside.waitsOn: this module: code the checker accepts under the standard's settings
tests: R1: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick for the scheduler; exploreAllowed decides each owner and question; null opens one run, at most one a question a day

R2: worth exploring: open or surfaced, at least one member receives its finds, and never explored or a capture resolving to its subject entity gained since its last run; bounded at 200 a tick

R3: the run opens through ai-runs in the investigate run path, origin explore, use explore, the paying owner its principal and ai-use R6's label, as a system step on the question that ai-runs creates once the run is open (K2490)

R3: a principal served by a sign-in explores only while that sign-in account's explore use is on; off (its default) it is refused as any account whose explore use is off (ai-accounts R14 and ai-use R6, the real modules; the sign-in held, ai-accounts R19)
R12: each Ask item and each run carries ai-use R10's estimate before

R17: a condition outside CONDITION_KINDS is refused before anything is closed; one in it is passed to the close as given

R17: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick answer promises (scheduler R27 awaits them)
R17, R15: a store made before the close_refused column gains it at migrate(), its runs kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R16: on a test instance with no record and investigate's chain held, the gate is open on the exception: R4's answer carries false_alarm_rate null, gold_set null and untested the label, and each find R5 offers carries it; control: a non-test instance with no record stays shut, R5 answering nothing
R16: the exception lifts only the bar: with investigate's verification chain not held the gate stays shut on a test instance; a part the exception does not admit shuts it

R16, R15: a store made before the label gains its column at migrate(), its finds kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R4: each find (a capture, content row or connection the run located) is gauged supports, cuts_against or unclear against the question's live basis, answered {bearing, how, false_alarm_rate, gold_set, label: machine, enabled_by} (R16: untested null under the bar)
R4: the gauge is never a grade, never stored as a score, and never hides, ranks or orders what members see

R5: a recipient who may not see the question, or the document a find rests on, is not offered it

R6: a find's only doors are a member's: dismiss (the queue's in a drawing project; a follower outside every one mutes it), accept by one act in record-grammar R52's forms, hold a hypothesis, or start a step; nothing here writes a leg, a grade, a conclusion or a hypothesis
R6: a follower outside every drawing project mutes a find; a participant of a drawing project dismisses it through the queue, not here

R7: finds are offered only while the gate is open: the explorer passed its bar on Civicsmith's test investigations, its false-alarm rate at most 20% and recorded, and run-rules R19 lets investigate and the explorer's use deploy; closed, findsFor answers nothing and counts nothing, and no member is offered exploring

R10: an exploring run gathers about at most 20 distinct persons; a look past the cap is refused EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED and the run ends its step set_aside with that reason
R12: at its close each run carries ai-runs R76's actual cost, answered to the paying account's owners only
R13: a run reads inside a held document through run-productions R24, a few pages at a time within its pages bound, never a document under a no-AI material limit; it says how far it read
R13: what an exploring run proposes while reading is run-productions R21's, under its step (K2502); a proposed connection to a person passes R9's gate first

R13: the material limit is read from ai-accounts (its R22's aiKeptAway, asked with the document's project and the use explore); a read that throws is answered its fail-closed refusal (ai-accounts R34's KEPT_AWAY_UNREADABLE), nothing read
R5 R8 R9 R10 (plan rule 6): the module's keys are the owner's declared list for question-explorer, every one held by the word list
R4 R6 R8 R9 R10 R13 (plan rule 6): every refusal row's translation is the word of its refusal.<CODE> key, read through setup-words, and none says group where the list says team
R5 R8 R12 (plan rule 6): the system step's words, an offered find's and a stop's are the list's, and the gate's reasons and estimate too
R6 R13 (plan rule 6): a find's route and a proposal's aim are the list's words; a placeholder with no value is refused, never answered bare
R1: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick for the scheduler; exploreAllowed decides each owner and question; null opens one run, at most one a question a day
R1: a refusal from exploreAllowed opens nothing and the next owner is asked; {ask: true} records exploreAsk with the questions and their estimate, and nothing runs that day without approval
R2: worth exploring: open or surfaced, at least one member receives its finds, and never explored or a capture resolving to its subject entity gained since its last run; bounded at 200 a tick
R2: R9 holds before it: a question about a person no member tied is never chosen; one a member raised about that person is

R3: the run opens through ai-runs in the investigate run path, origin explore, use explore, the paying owner its principal and ai-use R6's label, as a system step on the question that ai-runs creates once the run is open (K2490)

R3: a principal served by a sign-in explores only while that sign-in account's explore use is on; off (its default) it is refused as any account whose explore use is off (ai-accounts R14 and ai-use R6, the real modules; the sign-in held, ai-accounts R19)
R12: each Ask item and each run carries ai-use R10's estimate before

R3: a member's account's explore switch is read through ai-accounts' in-plane accountUsesOf (its R17), never accountUses as that member; an account that cannot be read is refused before ai-use is asked (fail closed)
R17: the cap ends the run closed: ai-runs' asynchronous close is awaited and accepted, bound completed and condition null, the step set aside with EXPLORE_PERSON_CAP_REACHED

R17: end({end: "ended"}) closes with bound completed and no condition, and the words for the ending are not this module's
R17: a condition outside CONDITION_KINDS is refused before anything is closed; one in it is passed to the close as given

R17: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick answer promises (scheduler R27 awaits them)
R17, R15: a store made before the close_refused column gains it at migrate(), its runs kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R16: on a test instance with no record and investigate's chain held, the gate is open on the exception: R4's answer carries false_alarm_rate null, gold_set null and untested the label, and each find R5 offers carries it; control: a non-test instance with no record stays shut, R5 answering nothing
R16: the exception lifts only the bar: with investigate's verification chain not held the gate stays shut on a test instance; a part the exception does not admit shuts it
R16: whenever the explorer's bar is held, R7's recorded false-alarm rate of at most 20% applies and no label is carried, on a test instance too; a find keeps the label it was gauged under
R16, R15: a store made before the label gains its column at migrate(), its finds kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R4: each find (a capture, content row or connection the run located) is gauged supports, cuts_against or unclear against the question's live basis, answered {bearing, how, false_alarm_rate, gold_set, label: machine, enabled_by} (R16: untested null under the bar)
R4: the gauge is never a grade, never stored as a score, and never hides, ranks or orders what members see

R5: findsFor answers each find, once (keyed per find and question), to each of steps.findRecipients who may see both the find and the question; labelled the system's, never a project's; which account paid only to its owners
R5: a recipient who may not see the question, or the document a find rests on, is not offered it

R6: a find's only doors are a member's: dismiss (the queue's in a drawing project; a follower outside every one mutes it), accept by one act in record-grammar R52's forms, hold a hypothesis, or start a step; nothing here writes a leg, a grade, a conclusion or a hypothesis
R6: a follower outside every drawing project mutes a find; a participant of a drawing project dismisses it through the queue, not here

R7: finds are offered only while the gate is open: the explorer passed its bar on Civicsmith's test investigations, its false-alarm rate at most 20% and recorded, and run-rules R19 lets investigate and the explorer's use deploy; closed, findsFor answers nothing and counts nothing, and no member is offered exploring

outside.waitsOn: this module: code the checker accepts under the standard's settings
tests: R1: exploreDue, exploreWake and exploreTick for the scheduler; exploreAllowed decides each owner and question; null opens one run, at most one a question a day

R3: the run opens through ai-runs in the investigate run path, origin explore, use explore, the paying owner its principal and ai-use R6's label, as a system step on the question that ai-runs creates once the run is open (K2490)

R3: a principal served by a sign-in explores only while that sign-in account's explore use is on; off (its default) it is refused as any account whose explore use is off (ai-accounts R14 and ai-use R6, the real modules; the sign-in held, ai-accounts R19)
R12: each Ask item and each run carries ai-use R10's estimate before

R16, R15: a store made before the label gains its column at migrate(), its finds kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R4: the gauge is never a grade, never stored as a score, and never hides, ranks or orders what members see

R5: a recipient who may not see the question, or the document a find rests on, is not offered it

R6: a follower outside every drawing project mutes a find; a participant of a drawing project dismisses it through the queue, not here

R3: the run opens through ai-runs in the investigate run path, origin explore, use explore, the paying owner its principal and ai-use R6's label, as a system step on the question that ai-runs creates once the run is open (K2490)

R12: each Ask item and each run carries ai-use R10's estimate before

R3: a member's account's explore switch is read through ai-accounts' in-plane accountUsesOf (its R17), never accountUses as that member; an account that cannot be read is refused before ai-use is asked (fail closed)

R17: a condition outside CONDITION_KINDS is refused before anything is closed; one in it is passed to the close as given

R16, R15: a store made before the label gains its column at migrate(), its finds kept, and migrate() stays idempotent

R4: the gauge is never a grade, never stored as a score, and never hides, ranks or orders what members see

R6: a follower outside every drawing project mutes a find; a participant of a drawing project dismisses it through the queue, not here

R6: a find's only doors are a member's: dismiss (the queue's in a drawing project; a follower outside every one mutes it), accept by one act in record-grammar R52's forms, hold a hypothesis, or start a step; nothing here writes a leg, a grade, a conclusion or a hypothesis
R6: a follower outside every drawing project mutes a find; a participant of a drawing project dismisses it through the queue, not here

R7: finds are offered only while the gate is open: the explorer passed its bar on Civicsmith's test investigations, its false-alarm rate at most 20% and recorded, and run-rules R19 lets investigate and the explorer's use deploy; closed, findsFor answers nothing and counts nothing, and no member is offered exploring
R11: a group's own test investigations measure the explorer too; the result, with its false-alarm rate, is answered to that group's members only, and never opens or closes R7's gate
